headline: Ansaldo Energia Wins Contract to Supply Gas Turbines in Vietnam
summary: Italy's Ansaldo Energia was selected by Trungnam Group to supply two gas turbines and two generators for a new power generation plant in Vietnam.
why: Ansaldo Energia manufactures heavy power plant machinery, supplying energy infrastructure projects globally.

impacts.name: Ansaldo Energia
impacts.why: Ansaldo Energia secured an equipment supply agreement for a power plant in Vietnam.
